expectedIssues: Promo banner text is unreadable, white text on a pale mint background
reportedIssues: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the restaurant list content. The second restaurant card is cut off behind the bottom nav, making the page look clipped and potentially hiding tappable content.
The promotional banner uses white text on a very light mint background, resulting in low contrast and poor readability.

Several horizontal carousel items are partially cut off at the right edge, such as the category chip after 'Healthy' and the third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you'. While this may indicate horizontal scrolling, it can look visually unfinished without clearer spacing or scroll affordance.
Favorite heart buttons sit on dark image areas with a dark translucent circular background, which reduces visual separation in some cards.

expected.reasoning: Reported issue 1 directly describes white text on light mint background with poor readability, matching the expected defect exactly.
